air-hill-bic-chambersburg-pa.assessment: Air Hill Brethren in Christ Church serves the Chambersburg area at the Cumberland Highway corridor. Senior Pastor John Melhorn — a Messiah College alumnus who reports a teen conversion experience — leads this Atlantic Conference congregation. Brethren in Christ blends Anabaptist peace tradition with Wesleyan-Holiness soteriology — mission-minded but synergistic. For a Chambersburg-area man wanting a settled BIC congregation in the historic Mason-Dixon BIC heartland, Air Hill is worth a visit. Denominational gender yellow stands.
